beats.text: A newspaper called Alfred Nobel the merchant of death.
beats.note: In 1888 his brother Ludvig died in France, and a French paper is said to have mistaken it for Alfred's death.

beats.name: Ludvig Nobel
beats.role: Alfred's brother, who died in France that year. The death is the part of the story that is not in doubt.

beats.note: Historians have not located an original copy, and some now treat the story as a myth.

beats.name: Alfred Nobel
beats.role: Signed his final will on 27 November at the Swedish-Norwegian Club in Paris, leaving his estate to fund five prizes.

beats.note: The Nobel Foundation points to an 1868 award from the Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences as a possible origin of the science prizes. The peace prize is often linked to his friendship with Bertha von Suttner.

beats.text: The best known origin story is the one nobody can show you.

beats.line: The first prizes were awarded in 1901.
